guardrails-poc.challenge: Regulators require proof that AI output is safe; policy documents cannot prove it.
guardrails-poc.action: Built 3,600 test cases, ran them, and compared the guardrail with built-in protection.
guardrails-poc.result: Recommended skipping an add-on guardrail for now and using the platform's built-in one.

agentic-platform-eval.challenge: A wrong agent platform could fail halfway through a build or after launch.
agentic-platform-eval.action: Designed and ran hands-on tests on two platforms, scored on the same scorecard.
agentic-platform-eval.result: Found 12 issues before purchase, including 4 launch blockers and 1 security issue.

agent-cost-roi.challenge: Four agents with different cost structures were hard to compare for funding.
agent-cost-roi.action: Built a prototype for each agent and designed one shared cost-benefit formula.
agent-cost-roi.result: All four agents can now be compared side by side; their baselines are in progress.

agent-loan-assistant.challenge: Applicants with questions often leave the platform when no one answers in time.
agent-loan-assistant.action: Built a Loan Assistant prototype and defined metrics based on applications.
agent-loan-assistant.result: The measurement framework is done; the baseline awaits volume data from the business.

agent-credit-review.challenge: Underwriters check financial documents one by one; slow, with uneven standards.
agent-credit-review.action: Built the Smart Underwriting prototype and set unit cost and a 3-year baseline.
agent-credit-review.result: The cost baseline is done and production resources are confirmed.

agent-customer-service.challenge: Agents look things up mid-call and still write notes after hanging up.
agent-customer-service.action: Built the assistant prototype and designed a cost-per-call framework.
agent-customer-service.result: Framework and call baseline are done; waiting on the vendor's updated estimate.

agent-wealth-assistant.challenge: Customers must dig through every account to see where their assets stand.
agent-wealth-assistant.action: Led the PoC and launch planning, and built the mobile banking prototype myself.
agent-wealth-assistant.result: Q&A is proven, launch resources are confirmed, and the prototype works.

agent-governance.challenge: The FSC principles are clear, but nobody could say how to check them.
agent-governance.action: Turned the six principles into a nine-cell table: three layers times three questions.
agent-governance.result: The check framework is done, and new AI projects can reuse it.

finllm.challenge: A finance model that learns from wrong data can break regulations.
finllm.action: Cleaned training data item by item and scored the model's reading of regulations.
finllm.result: Finished cleaning batch 2-1 and regulatory scoring for batch 4.

gemini-training.challenge: Employees did not know how to use AI safely in their own work.
gemini-training.action: Designed an AI course with hands-on practice on each business unit's own scenarios.
gemini-training.result: Course outline confirmed; collecting business scenarios is in progress.

ai-ops-dashboard.challenge: Each AI track had its own numbers, but none showed whether AI was worth it.
ai-ops-dashboard.action: Designed metrics on five parts: adoption, quality, value, cost, and risk.
ai-ops-dashboard.result: The metric framework is designed; the dashboard is still in planning.

a2ui-research.challenge: Wealth info in plain text is hard to read; AI-written web code fails security.
a2ui-research.action: Assessed A2UI along a product journey and mapped three candidate use cases.
a2ui-research.result: Candidate use cases are mapped; PoC resources are being confirmed.

webai-finance.challenge: Researchers had to collect and organize data every day before research could start.
webai-finance.action: Built an AI assistant that answers market and stock questions from organized data.
webai-finance.result: Launched in production, cutting researchers' time to collect and organize data.

ai-governance-review.challenge: Subsidiary AI reports were reviewed one by one by hand: slow, with uneven standards.
ai-governance-review.action: AI judges the content; the system recalculates risk and checks the asset register.
ai-governance-review.result: The system checks and recalculates first, then hands results to a reviewer.

rag-support-bot.challenge: Answers were spread across manuals; members who could not find one waited for support.
rag-support-bot.action: Built an AI bot that answers from the manuals, and improved how documents are split.
rag-support-bot.result: Accuracy rose from 60% to 85%, with replies in about 2 to 3 seconds.

multi-agent-advisory.challenge: One AI struggles to weigh technicals, news sentiment, and fundamentals at once.
multi-agent-advisory.action: Designed five AI Agents that split work and debate like a fund team to give signals.
multi-agent-advisory.result: A 3-year Taiwan stock backtest gave the team confidence in the design.

asr-transcription.challenge: Someone had to transcribe each earnings call video by hand, which took a long time.
asr-transcription.action: Used Whisper to turn videos into transcripts and summary tables automatically.
asr-transcription.result: Cut the time to prepare earnings call notes.

moda-t-ambassador.challenge: Rural groups and small firms lack AI talent, so adopting generative AI alone is hard.
moda-t-ambassador.action: Developed digital solutions with companies and helped them adopt generative AI.
moda-t-ambassador.result: Completed the program and helped companies adopt generative AI and AIoT.

tmba-cta-taiex.challenge: A strategy is taken seriously only if its results are repeatable and measurable.
tmba-cta-taiex.action: Built a TAIEX futures strategy with a repeatable backtest, judged on three measures.
tmba-cta-taiex.result: The strategy won 3rd place at the TMBA showcase.

tmba-event-earnings-call.challenge: Can an earnings call give a signal you can trade?
tmba-event-earnings-call.action: Designed a Taiwan stock strategy around earnings calls and backtested return and risk.
tmba-event-earnings-call.result: Strategy details and backtest results: to be added.

thesis-rag-panel.challenge: Traditional financial ratios explain only a small part of stock return changes.
thesis-rag-panel.action: Built an AI system that scores financial statements, then tested it with statistics.
thesis-rag-panel.result: The model's explanatory power rose from 5.14% to 63.73%.

fubon-esg-portfolio.challenge: Does ESG add value in stock investing?
fubon-esg-portfolio.action: Our team picked Taiwan stocks and built ESG factors into the portfolio allocation.
fubon-esg-portfolio.result: Finished the project and presented to fund managers; results to be added.

thesis-esg-capital-structure.challenge: Do ESG risk scores affect the capital structure of Taiwanese companies?
thesis-esg-capital-structure.action: Studied the link between ESG risk scores and capital structure in a thesis.
thesis-esg-capital-structure.result: Thesis done and degree earned; findings to be added.

tunghai-english-ta.challenge: Students learning statistics, economics, and finance in English need a TA.
tunghai-english-ta.action: Served as teaching assistant for three English-taught courses.
tunghai-english-ta.result: Completed the TA role for all three; duties to be added.

finjourney.challenge: Personal finance data is scattered, so it is hard to see where the problem is.
finjourney.action: Built, alone, an AI finance product that shows all finances on one chart.
finjourney.result: Live product; the AI advisor only proposes plans and the system does the math.

vibe-edge.challenge: AI creates strategies so fast it can find results that only look good by luck.
vibe-edge.action: Built a testing gate AI cannot change, and recorded every trial.
vibe-edge.result: The full flow from raw data to a paper trading list now runs end to end.

fincli.challenge: Much Taiwan stock data has no ready-made tool and must be connected one by one.
fincli.action: Built a tool that automatically collects raw data after each market close.
fincli.result: It updates automatically every day and is Vibe-Edge's data source.

openstrategy.challenge: Can investor conferences produce excess returns that can be traded?
openstrategy.action: Analyzed prices around conferences and combined the useful factors into stock picks.
openstrategy.result: In 2025 it slightly trailed the market's 0.99 and missed the target; finding why is next.
